description: Ministry of Youth & Sports - Amend the Regulations - Control participants in Sports representing Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It amends previous regulations and establishes new regulatory requirements for national sports selection committees, including procedures for selection trials, documentation requirements, and approval processes. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing regulations under statutory authority.
